_doc: Default council. Override or extend in ~/.config/roundtable/seats.json (same shape; adapters/presets merge by key, seats patch by id). Placeholders: {model} {prompt} {prompt_file} {out_file}. format: how to read the answer and token usage (claude-json, codex-jsonl, grok-json, opencode-jsonl; absent = plain text, no tokens).

claude._note: --restricted ignores user/project/local settings, so the user's hooks (SessionStart context, prompt hooks) and auto-memory never reach a seat. plan mode injects 'spawn agents, ExitPlanMode' instructions; dontAsk denies anything not allowlisted. Read/Grep/Glob replace cat/rg; no git diff/log (--output writes), no rg (--pre runs), no code execution. --strict-mcp-config drops MCP servers that publish externally

codex._note: apps/computer_use/browser_use expose 100+ tools that can deploy, share or click; a council seat needs none of them

grok._note: plan mode ends headless runs with exit_plan_mode and prints only the opening line; read-only sandbox is kernel-enforced outside temp dirs

agy._note: plain text output: no token figures (its --output-format json was not verifiable, see research.md). no --dangerously-skip-permissions: it can lift the sandbox (agy issue #36). Headless then denies tools that need a prompt (read_url); the seat continues without them. With --workspace it still reads a snapshot copy, never the real checkout

opencode._note: `run --format json` prints no token counts; they are read back with `session export` (local, no model call)
